name: agent-harness
description: Agent skills (work in Claude Code, Codex and other agents) and Claude Code mods from Jared Schulman's daily setup.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Save a coding session to a handoff file and get a paste-ready prompt for the next session; resume from it with one next action; or close out cleanly without a file.

plugins.name: drift-watch
plugins.description: Side panel that checks whether a Claude Code session is drifting from its goal, who moved it, and flags deploys and stuck helpers. Uses Haiku for each check.

plugins.name: multi-review
plugins.description: Independent code review by several model families (host agent, Codex CLI, Gemini via agy) in parallel, combined into one SHIP / SHIP WITH AMENDMENTS / DO NOT SHIP verdict.

plugins.name: codex-loop
plugins.description: Plan, have Codex CLI attack the plan, get human approval, then have Codex build it step by step with proof checks and an independent final review.

plugins.name: wave-digest
plugins.description: A small, runnable example of wave orchestration: three parallel read-only workers scan a folder of projects (git activity, TODO/FIXME, recently changed notes), the orchestrator validates their files, and one writer combines them into digest.md.

plugins.name: sessions-panel
plugins.description: /sessions: a pane listing live Claude Code and Codex sessions on this computer (status, context, memory, subagents, helper programs), with a confirm-first End button for idle ones

plugins.name: context-nudge
plugins.description: Shows a Hand off / Dismiss strip when the context window passes 40%, and at 45% and 65% tells Claude to wrap up and recommend a handoff or /compact (never runs either)

plugins.name: short-and-sweet
plugins.description: A per-chat switch that keeps Claude replies to 1-3 plain sentences unless you ask for more, with a Tell me more button

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Status-line countdown of minutes left before the prompt cache expires, using the cache lifetime the API reports

plugins.name: explain-like-im-12
plugins.description: Plain-English, analogy-driven explanations of technical topics, with a named breakdown point.

plugins.name: explain-deck
plugins.description: Turn a topic from your own local files into a short offline HTML explainer deck with speaker notes, a source on every slide and a self-quiz.

plugins.name: market-map
plugins.description: Build a market map from public filings that name both buyer and service provider: concentration by size band, with an honest denominator.
